## Decision

Output depth: research design

Route this as a descriptive health-care-utilisation study, not a causal study.
Target-trial readiness is not applicable to the stated intent.

## Research question and study-design routing

Estimate utilization counts, rates, and distributions for a defined population,
care setting, observation period, and denominator. RWD are routinely collected
data; findings are not automatically RWE without fit-for-purpose analysis and
an evidence-generating design appropriate to the claim.

## Evidence table

Document source provenance, refresh snapshot, population coverage, capture of
care settings, terminology versions, and known changes over time.

## Data contract

Specify unit of analysis, person and event keys, observation eligibility,
utilization event definition, date precision, denominators, deduplication,
missingness, source coverage, lineage, and synthetic acceptance fixtures.

## Code maturity

`conceptual`; no executable institutional analysis is claimed.

## Validation gaps

Assess fitness for the intended descriptive measures, incomplete capture,
site and calendar-time changes, missingness, denominator construction, and
external generalizability. No causal interpretation is offered.

## Sources

- Study request and approved descriptive protocol, when available.
- Current data-provenance and source-quality documentation, when supplied.
